title: ferocactus wislizeni subsp. tiburonensis
intro: Ferocactus wislizeni subsp. tiburonensis, commonly known as Tiburon Pincushion Cactus, is a subspecies of cactus in the Ferocactus genus, native to the Baja California Peninsula in Mexico. The Tiburon Pincushion Cactus is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. It has been reported to have health benefits such as wound healing and anti-inflammatory properties, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions like antiseptic and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
